methods.name: update
methods.summary: If a zone has multiple SSL certificates, you can set the order in which they should be used during a request.
methods.description:
If a zone has multiple SSL certificates, you can set the order in which they
should be used during a request. The higher priority will break ties across
overlapping 'legacy_custom' certificates.

props.name: zone_id
props.description: Identifier.

props.name: certificates
id
props.description: Identifier.

props.name: priority
props.description:
The order/priority in which the certificate will be used in a request. The
higher priority will break ties across overlapping 'legacy_custom' certificates,
but 'legacy_custom' certificates will always supercede 'sni_custom'
certificates.
Array of ordered certificates.

methods.name: create
methods.summary: Upload a new SSL certificate for a zone.
methods.description: Upload a new SSL certificate for a zone.

props.name: zone_id
props.description: Identifier.

props.name: certificate
props.description: The zone's SSL certificate or certificate and the intermediate(s).

props.name: bundle_method
props.description:
A ubiquitous bundle has the highest probability of being verified
everywhere, even by clients using outdated or unusual trust stores. An optimal
bundle uses the shortest chain and newest intermediates. And the force bundle
verifies the chain, but does not otherwise modify it.

props.name: custom_csr_id
props.description: The identifier for the Custom CSR that was used.

props.name: deploy
props.description:
The environment to deploy the certificate to, defaults to
production.

props.name: geo_restrictions
props.description:
Specify the region where your private key can be held locally for
optimal TLS performance. HTTPS connections to any excluded data center will
still be fully encrypted, but will incur some latency while Keyless SSL is used
to complete the handshake with the nearest allowed data center. Options allow
distribution to only to U.S. data centers, only to E.U. data centers, or only to
highest security data centers. Default distribution is to all Cloudflare
datacenters, for optimal performance.

props.name: policy
props.description:
Specify the policy that determines the region where your private key
will be held locally. HTTPS connections to any excluded data center will still
be fully encrypted, but will incur some latency while Keyless SSL is used to
complete the handshake with the nearest allowed data center. Any combination of
countries, specified by their two letter country code
(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2#Officially_assigned_code_elements)
can be chosen, such as 'country: IN', as well as 'region: EU' which refers to
the EU region. If there are too few data centers satisfying the policy, it ...

props.name: private_key
props.description:
The zone's private key. Not required if custom_csr_id is provided,
in which case the private key is retrieved from the CSR record held by
Cloudflare.

props.name: type
props.description:
The type 'legacy_custom' enables support for legacy clients which do
not include SNI in the TLS handshake.

'legacy_custom' certificates will always supercede 'sni_custom' certificates.

props.name: match
props.description: Whether to match all search requirements or at least one (any).
